text: One day at a local shop. Nine ways to tell it.
Five thirty. Before the street wakes, the shutter goes up.
asr: 5.30. Before the street wakes, the shutter goes up.

text: Eleven. A new arrival, straight into the glass case.
Three. A neighbour orders from her phone.
The order crosses two streets, and arrives in minutes.
Six. The after-school quest for sweets.
Nine. The street goes quiet. One lamp stays lit.
One shop. One day. Now online, with PawanSetu.
say: One shop. One day. Now online, with Pawansetu.
asr: One Shop One Day Now Online with Pawan Setu
